data.name: Rose
data.description:
Name: Rose(Ike)(Full name: Rosrail Willows Venom McClous-Sheens II)
Gender: Male
Age: 43(immortal)
Height: 6,7
Weight: infinity
Misc: Metal arms and a left leg(has concealed blade and claws), a burn mark on his lower face which was later ripped off during the Fray, He also has brimstone wings and horns from birth. He is known as the God of Creation after his mother died. He also has what seems like infinite tea-filled canteens, diaries, and notebooks. He had bloody bandages on his jaw.
Eye Color: Gold with black sclera. He has a third eye which has a golden glow when opening it called, Creation's Eye. 
Hair Color: Dark Brown
Weapon: A materializer (pentagonal item)(Axe, Whip, Spear, Mace, and Bow and Arrow), metal blades, claws, fists, and an ancient sword stronger than any other sword.
Power: The Eikons of FFXVI(Ifrit, Phoenix, Garuda, Ramuh, Titan, Bahamut, Shiva, Odin, Leviathan, Ultima)
Any other form: A large scarlet red dragon which can shoot meteor-like projectiles out of his mouth. He also has a devil form when he goes into his psychotic state. He uses every Eikon he has along with his wings and horns to combine them.
Lore: At birth, Rose’s father left because he was an outlaw who was never allowed to be with a goddess like his mother. At 7, he lost his family except his real father in a burning barn making the burn mark. A plank had fallen hard on his left arm, tearing it off. He got that metal arm from a young friend of his father. At 8, he was put into a military for the kingdoms of Ash and Soma. He enjoyed the Kingdom of Soma very well while he hated being at Ash. At 20, he was taught basic fighting skills by his father for him to learn the rest of the tradition. At 24, he established a group of people to follow his destiny and beliefs by their own will as he has been a slave for four years. He became the leader of a place called the Deadlands. At 26, he got hit with a hammer which somehow gave him the ability to sense someone in hiding. He was a very clever man. At 27, something got inside him in his sleep which gave him his other form making him a host.
Alternate State: Psychotic. Has a dark knife when going into the state. He calls the state, when it goes out of his head, Psycho
Not many know him.
Personality: calm, kind, silent, sleathy, combatic, humble
Personality(Psycho): relentless, psychotic, murder, manipulative, menacing, and malicious.
He also has a reliable, black, and white horse named, Mick. He could actually talk to him.
He has been through a crisis known as The Fray. The Fray was a series of events that traumatized or killed many people. More crystals started appearing with more A9(red mist that will turn you into a zombie-like entity) floods. The world was perishing. Him and 19 other people had stopped The Fray. The price was that one of them sacrificed themselves as well as the rest having to leave their world to go to other dimensions.
After all that has happened, he concealed his identity with a beige robe which covered his entire body as well as pitch black gloves. His gold eyes do still shine, but he hides any sign of abnormal stuff as a humanoid. He commonly hides himself and is silent. He sometimes will watch other people in the distance.
